raw:
"I remember feeling sad when my father missed my school play. I’d been looking forward to him seeing me in it. While I was at school for the play, I kept looking out into the audience, hoping I’d spot him. It was hard to keep my mind on what I was supposed to be doing because part of me was still waiting for him to arrive.

What hurt was that I wanted to share it with him. It mattered to me, and I wanted him to be there. I don’t want to guess at why he missed it, but I remember feeling disappointed and sad that he hadn’t seen me."
